The note says to exclude the center, but the required assert expects the center `[3, 4]` in the output, with all 9 cells in the 3×3 block. Excluding it would make that assert fail, so I'm keeping the original answer.

```python
def get_coordinates(test_tup):
    x, y = test_tup
    return [[i, j] for i in range(x - 1, x + 2) for j in range(y - 1, y + 2)]
```
